# CCA Duty — Rosyth Football CCA

Schedule, teacher duties and matches for the Football CCA (GitHub Pages version).

* `index.html`: the app (built from the Apps Script `Index.html`; do not edit by hand)
* `config.js`: the link to the Apps Script back office (`/exec` URL)
* `manifest.webmanifest`, `sw.js`, `icons/`: home-screen app set-up

Data lives in the CCA Duty App Mastercopy Google Sheet. Every change is checked by the Apps Script server, and cancelling, swapping and admin changes need the teacher's PIN.

Developed by Mr Salihin · Rosyth Football CCA
